question: If x - (1/x) = 10, then the value of x³ - (1/x3) is :
solution:
Given:

x - (1)/(x) = 10

Formula used:

x³ - (1)/(x³) = (x - (1)/(x))³ + 3(x - (1)/(x))

Calculations:

⇒ x³ - (1)/(x³) = 10³ + 3×10 = 1000 + 30 = 1030

∴ The value of x³ - (1)/(x³) is 1030.
